sentences.text: Paramore is the self-titled fourth studio album by American rock band Paramore .	Paramore	Paramore	rock	Rock music
It was released on April 5 , 2013 , through Fueled by Ramen as a follow-up to Brand New Eyes -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Fueled by Ramen	Fueled by Ramen	Brand New Eyes	Brand New Eyes
It is their first full-length album released after the departure of co-founders Josh and Zac Farro in 2010 .	Josh	Josh Farro	Zac Farro	Zac Farro
Recorded between April and November 1 , 2012 , the album was described by the band as being a `` statement '' and a reintroduction of the band to the world and to themselves .
It is the only album without Zac Farro on drums , and the final album recorded with bassist Jeremy Davis before he left the band in 2015 .	Zac Farro	Zac Farro	Jeremy Davis	Jeremy Davis
The album was produced by Justin Meldal-Johnsen , with lead guitarist Taylor York co-producing on four tracks .	Justin Meldal-Johnsen	Justin Meldal-Johnsen	Taylor York	Taylor York

In contrast to band 's previous work , the production of Paramore contains the band 's experimentation with new musical genres , such as new wave and funk rock , and features three acoustic interludes .	Paramore	Paramore	new wave	new wave music	rock	Rock music	funk rock	funk rock

Paramore received acclaim from music critics , who praised the band 's maturity and experimentation in terms of musicianship as well as Williams ' vocals and overall presence on the album .	Paramore	Paramore
Several publications included the album in their year-end lists , including The A.V. Club and The Guardian .	The A.V. Club	The A.V. Club	The Guardian	The Guardian
Paramore was a commercial success , debuting at number one on the US Billboard 200 with first-week sales of 106,000 copies .	Paramore	Paramore

The album also topped the charts in Argentina , Australia , Brazil , Ireland , and New Zealand , where it became their first album to reach the summit .	Argentina	Argentina	Australia	Australia	Brazil	Brazil	Ireland	Ireland	New Zealand	New Zealand
It also became their second chart topper in the United Kingdom .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom

In March 2016 , Paramore was certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America -LRB- RIAA -RRB- , for sales exceeding 1,000,000 .	Paramore	Paramore	Recording Industry Association of America	Recording Industry Association of America

The group followed the record release with The Self-Titled Tour in promotion , with European , North American , Asian , Latin American , and Oceania legs announced .	The Self-Titled Tour	The Self-Titled Tour
In 2014 , Fall Out Boy and Paramore co-headlined Monumentour .	Paramore	Paramore	Fall Out Boy	Fall Out Boy	Monumentour	Monumentour
A deluxe edition of the album was released on November 24 , 2014 .

Four singles were released from the album : `` Now '' , `` Still Into You '' , `` Daydreaming '' , and the Grammy-winning song `` Ai n't It Fun '' .	Now	Now (Paramore song)	Still Into You	Still Into You	Daydreaming	Daydreaming (Paramore song)	Grammy	Grammy Award
